description: This file defines API functions for user, organization user, workspace user management, and subscription-related operations, exporting them as a default object.

methods.name: getUserById
methods.description: Fetches user data by user ID.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user data with provided body.

methods.name: getAllUsersByOrganizationId
methods.description: Retrieves all users associated with an organization ID.

methods.name: getUserByUserIdOrganizationId
methods.description: Fetches a user within an organization by organization ID and user ID.

methods.name: getOrganizationsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves organizations associated with a user ID.

methods.name: getAllUsersByWorkspaceId
methods.description: Retrieves all users within a workspace by workspace ID.

methods.name: getUserByRoleId
methods.description: Fetches users by role ID.

methods.name: getUserByUserIdWorkspaceId
methods.description: Fetches a user within a workspace by user ID and workspace ID.

methods.name: getWorkspacesByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves workspaces associated with a user ID.

methods.name: getWorkspacesByOrganizationIdUserId
methods.description: Retrieves workspaces associated with an organization ID and user ID.

methods.name: updateOrganizationUser
methods.description: Updates organization user data.

methods.name: deleteWorkspaceUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from a workspace.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsQuantity
methods.description: Gets the quantity of additional seats for a subscription.

methods.name: getCustomerDefaultSource
methods.description: Retrieves the default payment source for a customer.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsProration
methods.description: Calculates proration for additional seats.

methods.name: updateAdditionalSeats
methods.description: Updates the number of additional seats for a subscription.

methods.name: getPlanProration
methods.description: Calculates proration when changing plans.

methods.name: updateSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates the subscription plan with proration.

methods.name: getCurrentUsage
methods.description: Retrieves current usage data.

methods.name: deleteOrganizationUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from an organization.
